nodes.title: Mainstage
nodes.body: Welcome to the mainstage. Each sphere is a topic; lines between them are relationships. Click a sphere to focus on it, or click a line to see how two topics connect.

nodes.title: Topic A
nodes.body: Hot pink branch. Replace this body with your own content in data/graph.json.

nodes.title: Topic B
nodes.body: Ultraviolet thread. A different perspective from the mainstage; connected to Topic D.

nodes.title: Topic C
nodes.body: Acid-lime sub-stage. Connected to Topic A and Topic D.

nodes.title: Topic D
nodes.body: Sunset-orange anchor. Ties the lower half of the graph together.

nodes.title: Topic E
nodes.body: Gold front-stage topic. Connected to the mainstage and Topic C.

nodes.title: Topic F
nodes.body: Pink front-stage topic. Connected to the mainstage and Topic D.

nodes.title: Topic G
nodes.body: Sky-blue top-right topic. Connected to the mainstage and Topic A.

nodes.title: Topic H
nodes.body: Mint top-left topic. Connected to the mainstage and Topic B.
